description: 人民币中文大写、增值税价税分离（0–50% 税率）及支票出票日期大写 / Chinese RMB uppercase, VAT tax split, and PBOC cheque date uppercase. mode is auto-inferred when omitted (amount only -> rmb; amount+taxRatePercent -> both; date only -> cheque_date). Examples: {"amount": 12345.67}; {"amount": 11300, "taxRatePercent": 13}; {"date": "2026-10-20"}.

amount.description: 【rmb/invoice/both】金额（元，最多 2 位小数）/ Amount in CNY, e.g. 11300

direction.description: 【invoice/both】拆算方向：from_tax_included（含税倒算，默认）| from_tax_excluded（不含税正算）

mode.description: 可选模式（省略时自动推断）/ Optional mode: rmb | invoice | both | cheque_date

taxRatePercent.description: 【invoice/both】增值税税率百分数（如 13 表示 13%，范围 0–50）/ VAT rate in %, e.g. 13

name: convert_rmb_and_invoice_tax
title: 人民币大写与发票价税分离（妙用盒）
